pr_title: Only check known attributes in significant change support
pr_body:

<!--

  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

With this we limit the checked attributes to those which are considered as significant. These are only attributes with a value, but not a list.
Because the almost same logic is used in different platforms, i've decided to put them all into this PR.
_This will also avoid many full CI cycles_

comments: https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/106020 looks like support for significant change was added in the beta
family room is a zwave thermostat and living room is an ecobee (HomeKit) thermostat. I am guessing that `fan_modes`, `preset_modes`, and `hvac_modes` are the issue?
`old_attrs_s = {item for item in old_attrs.items() if not isinstance(item[1], list)}` this is ugly but maybe what is needed?
